title: Detect Cycles In 2d Grid
statement:
Given an `m x n` grid of lowercase letters, return whether it contains a cycle of length at least four made of cells with the same letter. Consecutive cells in the cycle must share a side. A move cannot immediately return to the cell visited in the previous move.

## Examples

```text
Input: grid = [["a", "a", "a", "a"], ["a", "b", "b", "a"], ["a", "b", "b", "a"], ["a", "a", "a", "a"]]
Output: true
```

```text
Input: grid = [["a", "b", "b"], ["b", "z", "b"], ["b", "b", "a"]]
Output: false
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= m, n <= 500`
- `grid` is an `m x n` matrix of lowercase English letters.
